# Implement User Sign Up

Status: To Do
Task ID: TM-03

**Description:**

Develop the **Sign Up** functionality. Users should be able to register with **email and password**. Ensure form validation, error handling, and smooth UX.

[https://www.figma.com/design/zAwYa5nDWE2YirHYPpNabw/Tasks-Management?node-id=1-1219&t=L7Jf026Stu5qCTd2-0](https://www.figma.com/design/zAwYa5nDWE2YirHYPpNabw/Tasks-Management?node-id=1-1219&t=L7Jf026Stu5qCTd2-0)

[](data:image/png;base64,)

**Requirements:**

- Page Route: `/sign-up`
- Create a `SignUp` page/component with a form containing:
  - Name
  - Email
  - Password
  - Confirm Password
  - Job Title
- Validate inputs:
  - Name validation (required)
    - **Allowed characters** → letters (A–Z, a–z) and possibly non-English letters (e.g., accented characters, Arabic letters)
    - **Optional spaces** → allow spaces between first/middle/last names
    - **Minimum length** → 3 characters
    - **Maximum length** → 50 characters
    - No multiple consecutive spaces
    - No numbers
    - **No special characters** like `@, #, $, %, ^, &, *`
    - No emojis or symbols
  - Valid email format (required)
  - Password validation (required)
    - **Minimum length** → 8 characters
    - **Maximum length** → 64 characters
    - No white-space
    - **At least one uppercase letter** (A–Z)
    - **At least one lowercase letter** (a–z)
    - **At least one digit** (0–9)
    - **At least one special character** (e.g. `!@#$%^&*`)
  - Confirm password must match password (required)
  - Job Title (optional)
- Use this API `/auth/v1/signup`
  - Body example:

    ```json
    {
      "email": "tesss787@gmail.com",
      "password": "Password123!",
      "data": {
        "name": "Mahmoud Taha",
        "job_title": "Frontend"
      }
    }
    ```

- After Sign up the use should be logged in and redirect the user to the **main page `/project`**
- Ensure responsive UI and accessibility

**Acceptance Criteria:**

- Invalid inputs are blocked with clear error messages.
- User is redirected to the main page page after sign-up.
